conditions: The relevant code is evaluated in an annotation scope immediately within a class scope, such as a type alias declared in a class body.
limitations: The claim does not generalize class-name visibility to ordinary method bodies or assert all forms of annotations use annotation scopes.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum or a material counterexample.

statement: The Python 3.13.0 execution reference documents that an annotation scope immediately within a class scope can use names from that class namespace.
